visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a black long-sleeved shirt and tan pants stands in a cluttered kitchen, preparing food at a stainless steel counter. Two Corgis, one brown and white and one lighter tan, sit on the tiled floor looking up expectantly. Shelves nearby are filled with dishes, food boxes, and a toaster oven. (2) The camera shifts focus between the woman and the dogs. The Corgis are highly active, looking back and forth between the food preparation and the camera. The brown Corgi wears a turquoise collar, while the lighter one has a pink collar. The background features various household items and storage containers. (3) A close-up view shows the two Corgis sitting close to each other on the floor. A hand enters the frame from the right to pet the head and neck of the lighter tan Corgi. The dogs remain focused on the woman in the background who continues her task. (4) The woman uses a pair of red-handled scissors to cut small pieces of food, which she then drops onto the floor for the dogs. Both Corgis immediately bow their heads to eat the treats. The scene ends with the dogs preoccupied with their food.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks in an animated, friendly Mandarin tone to the dogs, sounding cheerful. High-pitched, sharp barks from the Corgis are heard frequently, cutting through the speech. Background sounds include the faint clicking and rustling of food preparation at the counter. (2) The narrator continues his commentary, his voice rising in pitch as he laughs at the dogs' enthusiasm. The Corgis bark loudly and rhythmically, displaying high arousal. The acoustic environment has a slight room resonance typical of an indoor kitchen space with hard surfaces. (3) The male voice lowers slightly in intensity, becoming more affectionate as he interacts with the pets. The barking persists but becomes more intermittent. Sound of movement on the kitchen counter, including the clinking of ceramic bowls and the movement of plastic containers. (4) The distinct metallic sound of scissors cutting through a solid object is heard, followed by the soft sound of food hitting the floor. The dogs' sharp barks cease, replaced by the faint sounds of crunching and eating. The narrator offers a final few words.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a heartwarming moment where an owner interacts with their two Corgis during snack time. It captures the anticipation of the pets and the playful commentary of the person filming, aiming to share a relatable and joyful slice of life with pets.
